name: internet-court
title_zh: 两个 Agent 谈生意前先递过来的那本交易规则
tagline_zh: A2A 交易不再靠互信赌运气：支付、托管、委托权限、身份信誉全走统一协议。HTTP 402 一响。
tagline_en: Agent-to-agent deals without blind trust: payments, escrow, delegated permissions, identity & reputation on one.
desc_en: Entry point for Internet Court — the trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce. Use whenever an agent needs to transact with another agent or a paid service, or a user mentions agent payments, paid APIs (HTTP 402/x402), wallet custody or trust concerns, spending mandates, delegated permissions (ERC-7710/7715), escrow, agent identity or reputation (ERC-8004), negotiation between agents (A2A), agent j
why_zh: 把信任从口头承诺变成可执行协议：ERC-7710/7715 管授权，ERC-8004 管身份。
why_en: Turns trust into executable protocol: ERC-7710/7715 for permissions, ERC-8004 for identity, A2A negotiation with receipts.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 agent 间交易与支付场景，不处理人类合同纠纷；需要双方都接入 Internet Court 协议栈。
limit_en: Covers only agent-to-agent commerce & payments, not human contracts. Both parties must run Internet Court stack; solo side is read-only. No legal.
title_en: The transaction rulebook two agents read before doing.
